'''Hood Family "Bespinian Best" Ice Cream''' was a type of [[Ice cream/Legends|ice cream]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]]. The flavors it made included [[Denta bean ice cream|denta bean]], [[Trammistan chocolate ice cream|Trammistan chocolate]] and [[Beebleberry ice cream/Legends|beebleberry]]. The [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] cook [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]] used Hood family brand ice cream in his [[Neuvian sundae]]s served in [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] on the planet of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].

{{Food-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Hood family "Bespinian best" ice cream is a reference to [[Willrow Hood/Legends|Willrow Hood]], otherwise known as "ice cream maker guy."
